name: awk_tabs_justify
title: Tabs To Aligned Columns
prompt: write_file align.awk with content as a JSON array of lines: ["BEGIN { FS=\"\\t\" }", "{ printf \"%-6s %2s %5s\\n\", $1, $2, $3 }"]. Then run_awk script_path=align.awk input_path=data.tsv and submit exactly that stdout (do not invent output with run_lua).
